notes.title: Patch 1.5!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29482351/01b27b2192ceb2fc5a31ee14a2c58febed560058.jpg[/img]


[b]Patch 1.5[/b]

- All Skolk Trials implemented! Battle him 3 times to unlock a secret final battle! Find him during the levels and hit him for a possible battle! 
- Russian Language added!

[b] - 2 Secret Characters are In Game![/b] 
[i] The robot T.H.O.R. is now stuck in the Dungeon! Help him out!  [/i] 
HowTo( Spoiler )
[spoiler] (Spot him at the main menu and click on him)  [/spoiler]


[i]A special dessert may join the dungeon!  [/i] 
HowTo( Spoiler )
[spoiler] Press Tab 9 times in the main menu(only 9, not 10 or 7!) [/spoiler]
 
- more minor fixes.


Will you beat the dungeon?

notes.title: Patch 1.3 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29482351/ce3dde5cdaec1f233642ba19b5d02210a9622f38.png[/img]


Patch 1.3

- Changed the way some mechanics behave prior to moving out of the safe zone in some levels, they now only start acting after you leave the safe zone. This may helps the pacing when speedrunning.
-  'Skolk trial I' added
- Endgame Love letter added
- minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is Live! - A Welcome to New Languages!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29482351/7d11d8621479d0e53699f9f6b7608ab865755f91.png[/img]

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]* Seven new languages are available ingame!
There might be some errors in the translation, but as stated on a previous announcement http://steamcommunity.com/games/669960/announcements/detail/1431434135998767957 [/list]
[list]* German
* Portuguese
* Korean
* Chinese
* Japanese
* French
* Spanish
*
We will need your help to correct those errors whenever you spot any!

[/list]

Thanks again for playing! ːsteamhappyː
